title: NASA's Boeing Crew Flight Test Post-Scrub News Conference
description: NASA, Boeing, and ULA (United Launch Alliance) officials discussed details of a scrub decision made ahead of the second launch attempt for NASA's Boeing Crew Flight Test on June 1, 2024. Participants in the briefing included Steve Stich, manager, NASA’s Commercial Crew Program; Mark Nappi, vice president and program manager, Boeing’s Commercial Crew Program; and Tory Bruno, president and CEO, ULA.
